performance_protocol.baseline_speedup: T(candidate, native Parlay, P=1) / T(same candidate build, P)
performance_protocol.end_to_end_improvement: T(frozen reference, one thread) / T(candidate, P workers)
performance_protocol.peers: FP/PlexEnum are optional release-level author-code comparisons, not required for every development edit
optional_diagnostics: algorithmic search-work differences from frozen reference and candidate one-worker control
performance_protocol.timeout_policy: Record censored/incomplete result; never zero answers, never completed-time or speedup denominator
performance_protocol.paper_comparability: Paper excludes loading; compare separately recorded compute-only time, never mix platforms or thread counts
run_metadata: fixed defaults and all non-input parameters
performance_protocol.parallel_non_regression_baseline: Same-worker best accepted Parlay implementation; for first runtime-port technique, also use the archived OpenMP parallel control as an explicitly labelled historical comparator.

small_and_sweet.theory: Explain W_local and total W/S on the actual candidate DAG, charging copying/initialization/synchronization/packing/allocation/output. Preserve a same-or-better comparable asymptotic reference work bound under common parameters/models/assumptions. Local algorithm changes are allowed; do not claim input-by-input O(actual reference work) or an unchanged search tree without proof. No hidden worker-dependent or logarithmic inflation.
small_and_sweet.simplicity: One clear idea per branch; prefer native Parlay primitives; no dataset/hardware dispatch tables; prefer zero new tuning knobs; universal justified defaults only.
small_and_sweet.generalization: Require paired same-input tests at one worker and multiple workers, across core cases, intermediate cases and predeclared held-out graph families. Persistent clear per-case serial or parallel regressions reject a technique even when geometric-mean speedup improves.
small_and_sweet.noise: At least three interleaved repetitions; investigate apparent regressions with additional paired repetitions; inconclusive/noisy/missing measurements remain pending, not accepted.
small_and_sweet.closure: Accepted only after both theory and experiment gates pass. A demonstrated inability to meet either gate closes as rejected with reasons on mainline technique.md; missing data/tooling is a non-terminal pending/blocked state.

required_for_acceptance: all perf_core cases including held-out cases
generalization_protocol.additional_scope: If a technique claims large-graph scheduling/memory benefits, predeclare representative perf_large case(s), complete them before accepting that claim, and retain every selected result.
generalization_protocol.missing_case_policy: Pending evidence, not a pass; do not silently drop or replace the held-out case
generalization_protocol.selection_freeze: Record the development/held-out split, same-worker comparison baseline and resource budget in technique.md before implementation; do not retune on held-out failures and still call them held out.

algorithm_adaptation_policy.scope: Parallel-motivated local changes to implementation or algorithm: pivot, branching, pruning, search/task partition, recovery, maximality implementation. Necessary adaptations can be part of one main technique.
algorithm_adaptation_policy.immutable_control: Do not modify the frozen reference or its expected answers to match a candidate.
algorithm_adaptation_policy.required_invariant: Same k-plex enumeration problem and complete, duplicate-free globally maximal result sets for identical normalized input and k/q.
not_required: Identical search tree or visited-node counts
Additional permission solely because local algorithm logic changes
algorithm_adaptation_policy.documentation: Mainline English technique.md must explain parallel obstacle, exact algorithm changes, correctness argument, comparable work/span/space analysis and experiments.
additional_checks: Measure candidate P=1 and P>1 and report search-work differences
Distinguish algorithmic improvement from runtime/scheduling speedup

host_resolution: Resolve actual host first. On ubuntu-server all tiers run directly; on Windows only budgeted smoke is local. Historical remote values are aliases of ubuntu-test-host, never a requirement to SSH to oneself.
